structured_output.summary:
South store is furnished in parts/room-13.mjs: log racks along the north partition, two rows of barrel stock with standing lanterns (z 26 and z 31), and a receiving table in front of the doorway as the focal piece (fence legs, slab top, ledger chest, lantern).
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the room line shows 92 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE. `mcd room` says OK: walk ok with 289 of 335 floor cells reachable, min light 8, 0 dark, 0 dim.
The stair 2 foot and head (x 3..4, z 24..30) and the lanes on z 25 and z 27 stay clear; the windows and loading-door fronts on z 32 are left open.
left: The 46 'unreached' cells listed by mcd room are y=15 cells above the furniture, not floor, so no walk problem; the verdict is OK.
mcd check reports 1848 floating blocks and 12 orphans, all from the roof and shell parts, none from this room.
plan.md's checklist has no room items, so nothing was ticked; elements.md has no South store item to tick.

waste.what: Placed each furniture cell by hand with local put()/span() helpers into three layer grids, then wrote the layers() legend.
waste.cost: About 90 cells placed by coordinate arithmetic; two passes (one to add the x5 barrel for light).
waste.tool: A `mcd furnish` command or a layers() variant that takes a list of [block, x, y, z] placements and an overlay onto the plan grid from `mcd plan`, so the generator needs no index arithmetic.

waste.what: Worked out the lantern lattice (standing lantern on a barrel, reach 6 Manhattan) by hand to clear the dark cells.
waste.cost: Four rounds of mental distance sums, one rebuild and one re-check.
waste.tool: The `mcd room` lantern-spot suggestion, run before the first placement, returning a complete list of barrel-or-post light spots, not just the best single spot.

waste.cost: Extra reading to confirm the verdict was still OK.
